about: The oldest ChartBridge each page version works with. nt8/update-pc.ps1 installs a page automatically only when the ChartBridge compiled on the PC is this version or newer. Keep it with the CHANGELOG: every release that needs a newer ChartBridge raises minChartBridge (and adds a line to history), and page follows package.json.

history.note: CHANGELOG 1.18.1: the Agent tab's rules in session time (18:00 to 15:25 across midnight, as ChartBridge 0.5.2 allows; an older ChartBridge refuses a window before 09:30 with its own reason) and its session trail across midnight; the LIVE account question names the mode the agent or the bot keeps; page only, no recompile

CHANGELOG 1.18.0: the Account tab's Hide and Show (ChartBridge 0.5.1; with an older ChartBridge, Archive on Gone accounts as before and no Show), and the order ticket ignoring the order messages ChartBridge 0.5.1 sends again after a snapshot without losing a note; page only, no recompile

CHANGELOG 1.17.0: the Agent tab (AI trading agents on ChartBridge 0.5.0's agent channel: their strip, modes, kill switch, proposals, notes and plans, rules and account); with an older ChartBridge the tab says it has no agents and everything else works as 1.16.0; page only, no recompile

CHANGELOG 1.16.0: the display round (no text inside charts, the Data Box, maximize, the stale feed edge, local fonts), the motion kit on the Bot tab only, and the parts that need ChartBridge 0.4.0 (the Account page, Order Strategies, Merge, the copier, the Bot tab, the quote-only markets) shown only when 0.4.0 says each switch is on; with 0.3.2 to 0.3.8 the page works as 1.15.0 plus the display round; page only, no recompile

CHANGELOG 1.15.0: the workspace gets 4h, 1D and 1W charts (NinjaTrader's own bars, ChartBridge 0.3.7 htf; older: the choices say they need 0.3.7), 30 days of history on 1 hour charts (10 on 15 minute), the drawing ring and the Zone, the corner readout, compact order labels, the Account panel and the Quote board (the change from the settlement needs 0.3.7), the note when a press on an order does nothing; /single.html as 1.14.0; page only, no recompile

CHANGELOG 1.14.0: the display round (no scrolling, panels resized from any edge, Time and Sales colors by ChartBridge 0.3.8's q, grid lines off by default, room right of price, zoom to brackets, the VWAP off the scale, bar countdown, ATR and % from the prior settlement (0.3.7), the single chart page's cleanup, versions shown, the page clock following the PC's); older ChartBridge: the tape by side and no settlement change; page only, no recompile

CHANGELOG 1.13.0: planned stop and target lines on a resting entry need ChartBridge 0.3.8 (older: no planned lines, as 1.12.0), no 200-tick bracket cap with 0.3.7 or newer, the NO STOP tag and one question per page load, Armed in deep red, the position readout redesign; page only, no recompile
CHANGELOG 1.12.1: chart signals (absorption bars, divergence arrows in the delta pane, large-order bubbles); page and engine only, no recompile; the signals need trade sides (ChartBridge 0.3.4)

CHANGELOG 1.12.0: the workspace is the main page (one connection per instrument, slim chart headers), its order ticket, order clicks on every chart of the ticket's instrument, one ticket across windows, the window's Flatten all; page only, no recompile
CHANGELOG 1.11.0: trading hotkeys set in Settings (Buy MKT, Sell MKT, B/E, Close, Flatten all); page only, no recompile
CHANGELOG 1.10.0: order bar essentials (bracket presets, qty 1 to 9, B/E, Shift+click by mouse button); page only, no recompile
CHANGELOG 1.9.0: color presets, indicator colors in the gears and the order bar following a light chrome; page and engine only, no recompile
CHANGELOG 1.8.0: the served window and the session table with ChartBridge 0.3.5; with 0.3.2 to 0.3.4.1 it loads as 1.6.0 did
CHANGELOG 1.7.0: the delta pane needs ChartBridge 0.3.4 for its sides (older: the pane shows a note, nothing else changes); 0.3.4.1 recommended (no historical quote requests)
CHANGELOG 1.6.1: page and engine only, works with ChartBridge 0.3.2, 0.3.3 and 0.3.4, no recompile
CHANGELOG 1.6.0: works with ChartBridge 0.3.2 and 0.3.3, no recompile
